# EpiDoc test fixtures

Small real EpiDoc samples used by `tests/test_epidoc_convert.py` to exercise
`scripts/documents/epidoc_convert.py`. Each file is an unmodified excerpt of
a single public document from an open-licence source. Credits:

## edh/ (Epigraphic Database Heidelberg)

`HD000001.xml`, `HD000003.xml`, `HD000044.xml`, `HD000058.xml`. Source:
Epigraphic Database Heidelberg, https://github.com/epigraphic-database-heidelberg/data.
Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Credit: "Epigraphische Datenbank Heidelberg", Heidelberg
Academy of Sciences and Humanities.

## isicily/ (I.Sicily)

`ISic000001.xml`, `ISic000005.xml`, `ISic000014.xml`, `ISic000046.xml`.
Source: I.Sicily, https://github.com/ISicily/ISicily. Licence: CC BY 4.0.
Credit: I.Sicily, University of Oxford Faculty of Classics, principal
investigator Jonathan Prag.

## papyri/ (papyri.info DDbDP and HGV)

`16901.xml`, `8666.xml` (DDbDP editions) and `hgv_16901.xml`, `hgv_8666.xml`
(matching HGV metadata records). Source: papyri.info,
https://github.com/papyri/idp.data. Licence: CC BY 3.0. Credit: Duke
Collaboratory for Classics Computing (DDbDP text), Heidelberger
Gesamtverzeichnis der Griechischen Papyrusurkunden Ägyptens (HGV metadata).

## edr/ (Epigraphic Database Roma)

`aEDR000006.xml`, `aEDR000153.xml`, `aEDR111313.xml`. Source: Epigraphic
Database Roma, Zenodo record https://zenodo.org/records/18468635. Licence:
CC BY 4.0 (record-level licence on the 2026-02-03 EpiDoc export). Credit:
Epigraphic Database Roma.
